data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The v4.2 update introduced changes to how we handle SSO tokens. Please have your IT team update the CloudDesk application integration within your Okta console. Specifically, confirm that the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL align with the updated values in our v4.2 configuration guide. [T-4485] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
